name: Create SD Holdings Co., Ltd.
summary: Create SD Holdings Co., Ltd., through its subsidiaries, engages in the drug store, prescription drug store, nursing care, and related businesses in Japan. The company sells medical and health products, medical devices, health foods, cosmetics, baby products, daily necessities, pet supplies, food products, and other items; and operates paid assisted living facilities and related businesses.
